text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
g.text: Building and stress-testing rotation strategies:
ETF rotation, momentum waterfalls across the Nasdaq
universe (with and without survivorship bias), and
cost-aware execution benchmarked against SPY. I care
more about whether a result survives realistic costs
and out-of-sample testing than about the headline
return.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
g.text: Before trusting a signal, I try to break it:
information-coefficient audits, redundancy maps
between features, and alpha-orthogonality tests to
check that each feature adds something the others
don't.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
g.text: Tree-based models (XGBoost, LightGBM LambdaRank),
SHAP for interpretation, and robust depth regression
for outliers, and above all knowing when a simpler
deterministic filter beats the model once costs and
robustness are included.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
g.text: Where I started: SDE-based predictive maintenance on
thermal time-series, and pricing optimisation under
raw-material risk.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
g.text: Designing pipelines of AI agents that automate parts
of the research workflow, from data ingestion and
feature generation to backtesting and reporting,
with the testing steps kept explicit and checkable.
